sdg:AbuseIndicator.label: abuse indicator

sdg:AcademicProgramRequirement.label: academic program requirement

sdg:AdoptionApplicationForm.label: adoption application form

sdg:AdultAdoptionProcess.label: adult adoption process

sdg:Age.label: age

sdg:AgendaSubject.label: agenda subject

sdg:AncestorVenerationCeremony.label: ancestor veneration ceremony

sdg:AnimationSequenceCreation.label: animation sequence creation

sdg:AppealWaiverCertification.label: appeal waiver certification

sdg:ApprovalRecommendation.label: approval recommendation

sdg:ArcticExpedition.label: arctic expedition
sdg:ArcticExpedition.definition: An ArcticExpedition is a process that involves at least one ExpeditionParticipant and utilizes at least one ExpeditionEquipment.

sdg:AssessmentMethod.label: assessment method
sdg:AssessmentMethod.definition: An act of appraisal used for standardized evaluation.

sdg:AssessmentParticipant.label: assessment participant
sdg:AssessmentParticipant.definition: A participant group involved in a team assessment.

sdg:AssessmentStandard.label: assessment standard
sdg:AssessmentStandard.definition: An AssessmentStandard is a DescriptiveICE that has at least one AssessmentMethod.

sdg:AssociationTable.label: Association Table

sdg:AthleticAttendantRole.label: athletic attendant role

sdg:AthleticMonitoringActivity.label: athletic monitoring activity
sdg:AthleticMonitoringActivity.definition: A video surveillance activity that tracks athlete performance.

sdg:AttendanceTrackingProcess.label: attendance tracking process
sdg:AttendanceTrackingProcess.definition: An AttendanceTrackingProcess is a process that participates in some StudentEntity.

sdg:AttributeColumn.label: Attribute Column
sdg:AttributeColumn.definition: A column realizing an ontology data property of the table's realized class.

sdg:AuditObjective.label: audit objective
sdg:AuditObjective.definition: An objective that guides an internal audit.

sdg:AuditTimestampColumn.label: Audit Timestamp Column
sdg:AuditTimestampColumn.definition: A column recording row lifecycle instants (creation, update) — provenance plumbing, planned by the generator's audit intent; asserts nothing about the domain.

sdg:AuthorizedEntity.label: authorized entity

sdg:AuthorizedRepresentativeRole.label: authorized representative role

sdg:AutomatedSystem.label: automated system
sdg:AutomatedSystem.definition: A control system that operates without human intervention.

sdg:AvailableTopping.label: available topping
sdg:AvailableTopping.definition: A portion of food available for consumption.

sdg:BCorporationMember.label: b corporation member
sdg:BCorporationMember.definition: A B corporation member is a role that realizes a process and is realized in a process.

sdg:BackShellDimensionSpec.label: back shell dimension spec
sdg:BackShellDimensionSpec.definition: A BackShellDimensionSpec is an information content entity that specifies a WidthMeasurement and a HeightMeasurement, and has a DepthValue.

sdg:BeneficiaryDesignation.label: beneficiary designation
sdg:BeneficiaryDesignation.definition: A BeneficiaryDesignation is a directive information content entity that designates a DesignatedBeneficiary and governs a RetirementBenefitOption.

sdg:BenefitOptionElection.label: benefit option election
sdg:BenefitOptionElection.definition: A BenefitOptionElection is a process that elects a RetirementBenefitOption and has a Member.

sdg:BioculturalResearchDesign.label: biocultural research design
sdg:BioculturalResearchDesign.definition: A BioculturalResearchDesign is a Process that employs some NutritionalAnthropologyMethod and addresses some ResearchQuestion.

sdg:BoardMeetingAgendaItem.label: board meeting agenda item
sdg:BoardMeetingAgendaItem.definition: A BoardMeetingAgendaItem is a process that is executed by some BoardMember and targets some AgendaSubject.

sdg:BoardMember.label: board member
sdg:BoardMember.definition: An organization member role that holds a seat on a board.

sdg:BoardMemberRole.label: board member role
sdg:BoardMemberRole.definition: {BoardMemberRole} is a role that has borne agent exactly one {IndependentContinuant}, and that is realized in some {BoardMemberRoleRealization}

sdg:BoardMemberRoleRealization.label: board member role realization
sdg:BoardMemberRoleRealization.definition: {BoardMemberRoleRealization} is a process that has participant some {BoardOfAssessorsMeeting}

sdg:BoardOfAssessorsMeeting.label: board of assessors meeting

sdg:BoardOfAuditorsRole.label: board of auditors role
sdg:BoardOfAuditorsRole.definition: A board of auditors role is a role that is realized in a process and realizes a process.

sdg:BoardOfEqualization.label: board of equalization
sdg:BoardOfEqualization.definition: A board that handles tax appeals.

sdg:BoundedMetricSeries.label: bounded metric series
sdg:BoundedMetricSeries.definition: A {BoundedMetricSeries} carries at most twelve decimal engagement metrics.

sdg:BreedingProgramApplication.label: breeding program application
sdg:BreedingProgramApplication.definition: A BreedingProgramApplication is an InformationContentEntity that contains a FormSection and identifies a HorseIdentity.

sdg:BuildingFloorStructure.label: building floor structure

sdg:BusinessActivityProcess.label: business activity process

sdg:BusinessDecision.label: business decision

sdg:BusinessEntity.label: business entity

sdg:BusinessInitiative.label: business initiative
sdg:BusinessInitiative.definition: A planned process that involves a business entity as its object.

sdg:BusinessPlan.label: business plan
sdg:BusinessPlan.definition: A BusinessPlan is an InformationContentEntity that describes a FutureBusinessScenario and targets an InvestorFundingSituation.

sdg:CalendarProduct.label: calendar product

sdg:CalendarProductSpecification.label: calendar product specification
sdg:CalendarProductSpecification.definition: A calendar system specification that relates to a calendar product.

sdg:CallAdmissionControl.label: call admission control
sdg:CallAdmissionControl.definition: A CallAdmissionControl is a process that evaluates a ServiceRequest and produces an AdmissionDecision.

sdg:CallVolume.label: call volume
sdg:CallVolume.definition: Call volume is a quality that measures the number of telephone calls occurring within a specified period.

sdg:CallVolumeMetric.label: call volume metric
sdg:CallVolumeMetric.definition: A measurement unit of volume that measures call volume.

sdg:CampaignCoordination.label: campaign coordination
sdg:CampaignCoordination.definition: A CampaignCoordination is an information content entity that coordinates some OnlineChannel and coordinates some OfflineChannel and hasEngagementMetric some decimal.

sdg:CancerPatient.label: cancer patient
sdg:CancerPatient.definition: A person who has a disease.

sdg:CancerSupportProgram.label: cancer support program
sdg:CancerSupportProgram.definition: A CancerSupportProgram is a BFO process that targets a CancerPatient and delivers a SupportService.

sdg:CareQualityAssessment.label: care quality assessment
sdg:CareQualityAssessment.definition: A quality specification that assesses the quality of clinical care.

sdg:CertificationTime.label: certification time
sdg:CertificationTime.definition: An hour that relates to a certificate.

sdg:CertifiedInternalAuditor.label: certified internal auditor
sdg:CertifiedInternalAuditor.definition: A material entity that has a certificate.

sdg:Chemical.label: chemical
sdg:Chemical.definition: A material entity that is a chemical substance or mixture.

sdg:ChemicalInstallation.label: chemical installation
sdg:ChemicalInstallation.definition: A chemical manufacturing facility that involves a chemical as an object.

sdg:ChiefComplianceOfficerRole.label: chief compliance officer role

sdg:ChildProtectionTeam.label: child protection team

sdg:ClearingBrokerRole.label: clearing broker role
sdg:ClearingBrokerRole.definition: {ClearingBrokerRole} is a role that inheres in exactly one {CustomerAccount}, and that is realized in some {ClearingBrokerServiceDeliveryProcess}

sdg:ClearingBrokerServiceDeliveryProcess.label: clearing broker service delivery process
sdg:ClearingBrokerServiceDeliveryProcess.definition: {ClearingBrokerServiceDeliveryProcess} is a process that has participant some {ClearingProcess}

sdg:ClearingProcess.label: clearing process
sdg:ClearingProcess.definition: A clearing process is a process that involves a financial product as an object.

sdg:Client.label: client

sdg:ClientProfile.label: client profile
sdg:ClientProfile.definition: A process profile that represents or relates to a specific network user or client.

sdg:ClinicalCare.label: clinical care

sdg:ClinicalDocumentationActivity.label: clinical documentation activity
sdg:ClinicalDocumentationActivity.definition: ClinicalDocumentationActivity is a process that utilizes an InformationSystem and records a PatientEncounter.

sdg:ClinicalEfficacyMonitoringSystem.label: clinical efficacy monitoring system
sdg:ClinicalEfficacyMonitoringSystem.definition: A clinical efficacy monitoring system is a material entity that realizes a monitoring protocol and abstracts a service performance metric.

sdg:ClinicalGenomicAnalysisProgram.label: clinical genomic analysis program
sdg:ClinicalGenomicAnalysisProgram.definition: A clinical genomic analysis program is a process that integrates a patient health profile and employs an analytical machine learning model.

sdg:ClinicalIntelligenceArtifact.label: clinical intelligence artifact
sdg:ClinicalIntelligenceArtifact.definition: A ClinicalIntelligenceArtifact is an information content entity that implementsMethod some AnalyticMethod.

sdg:ClinicalPerformanceData.label: clinical performance data
sdg:ClinicalPerformanceData.definition: Clinical quality data that quantifies or tracks health outcome metrics for performance evaluation.

sdg:ClinicalPerformanceDataEvaluation.label: clinical performance data evaluation
sdg:ClinicalPerformanceDataEvaluation.definition: A ClinicalPerformanceDataEvaluation is an InformationContentEntity that evaluates some ClinicalSystem and evaluates some IndividualClinician and has a decimal MetricValue.

sdg:ClinicalQualityImprovementProgram.label: clinical quality improvement program
sdg:ClinicalQualityImprovementProgram.definition: A ClinicalQualityImprovementProgram is a Process that utilizes some QuantitativeAnalyticTool and evaluates some ClinicalPerformanceData.

sdg:ClinicalSystem.label: clinical system
sdg:ClinicalSystem.definition: An infrastructure system dedicated to delivering clinical care services.

sdg:CloudStorageVolume.label: cloud storage volume
sdg:CloudStorageVolume.definition: A digital storage device partition or allocation used to hold database containers in a cloud environment.

sdg:CohortEnrollmentProcess.label: cohort enrollment process

sdg:CollateralExchangeProcess.label: collateral exchange process

sdg:CollegeAdministration.label: college administration
sdg:CollegeAdministration.definition: An organizational body responsible for the management and governance of a higher education institution.

sdg:CommunityHealthcareServiceDeliveryPr.label: community healthcare service delivery process
sdg:CommunityHealthcareServiceDeliveryPr.definition: {CommunityHealthcareServiceDeliveryProcess} is a process that has participant some {CommunityHealthcareSetting}

sdg:CommunityHealthcareSetting.label: community healthcare setting

sdg:ConceptConstructionProcess.label: concept construction process
sdg:ConceptConstructionProcess.definition: A ConceptConstructionProcess is a Process that constructsFrom a SubjectConcept and yieldsResult in a PredicateConcept.

sdg:CondimentStation.label: condiment station
sdg:CondimentStation.definition: A CondimentStation is a material entity that offers at least one AvailableTopping and is located at at least one StationLocation.

sdg:ConferenceProgramme.label: conference programme
sdg:ConferenceProgramme.definition: A conference programme is an information content entity that contains_presentation some academic presentation.

sdg:ConstructedPredicate.label: constructed predicate

sdg:PersonalDataRecord.label: personal data record
sdg:PersonalDataRecord.definition: A document content entity that contains personally identifiable information about an individual.

sdg:PersonalHealthProfile.label: personal health profile
sdg:PersonalHealthProfile.definition: A PersonalHealthProfile is an InformationContentEntity that incorporates GenomicData and incorporates ClinicalImagingData.

sdg:PersonalHealthRecord.label: personal health record
sdg:PersonalHealthRecord.definition: A PersonalHealthRecord is a CCO Information Content Entity that states some HealthCondition and is subject of some ClientProfile.

sdg:PersonallyIdentifiableInformation.label: personally identifiable information
sdg:PersonallyIdentifiableInformation.definition: An information content entity that identifies a person.

sdg:PetitionerRole.label: petitioner role
sdg:PetitionerRole.definition: {PetitionerRole} is a role that inheres in exactly one {Person}, and that 0000056 some {AdultAdoptionProcess}

sdg:PickDropLocation.label: pick drop location
sdg:PickDropLocation.definition: A PickDropLocation is a Continuant that is part of a TransportRoute.

sdg:PoliceOfficerRole.label: police officer role
sdg:PoliceOfficerRole.definition: {PoliceOfficerRole} is a role that is borne by exactly one {LawEnforcementAgency}, and that is realized in some {PolicePatrolProcess}

sdg:PolicePatrolProcess.label: police patrol process
sdg:PolicePatrolProcess.definition: {PolicePatrolProcess} is a process that has participant some {OperationalUnit}

sdg:PolicyViolation.label: policy violation
sdg:PolicyViolation.definition: A planned act that contravenes a specified institutional policy.

sdg:Population.label: population
sdg:Population.definition: A group of persons that is the subject of a prevalence rate.

sdg:PracticeSession.label: practice session
sdg:PracticeSession.definition: An act of training conducted specifically to improve professional skills through repetition.

sdg:PreclinicalImagingCore.label: preclinical imaging core
sdg:PreclinicalImagingCore.definition: A PreclinicalImagingCore is a material entity that has some direct part of type ImagingEquipment.

sdg:PredicateConcept.label: predicate concept
sdg:PredicateConcept.definition: A representational information content entity that expresses a constructed predicate.

sdg:PrevalenceRate.label: prevalence rate
sdg:PrevalenceRate.definition: A frequency representing the proportion of individuals in a specified population who have a particular condition or characteristic at a given time.

sdg:ProdmlDasAcquisition.label: PRODML DAS Acquisition
sdg:ProdmlDasAcquisition.definition: A distributed acoustic sensing acquisition process interrogating a fiber optical path; its raw/processed arrays land in HDF5 per the PRODML DAS transfer.

sdg:ProdmlDasRawDataSet.label: PRODML DAS Raw Data Set
sdg:ProdmlDasRawDataSet.definition: The raw/FBE/spectra array dataset of a DAS acquisition — the HDF5-resident payload a conforming file's groups and datasets map to.

sdg:ProdmlDtsMeasurementTrace.label: PRODML DTS Measurement Trace
sdg:ProdmlDtsMeasurementTrace.definition: A temperature-versus-depth measurement trace produced by a DTS survey.

sdg:ProdmlDtsSurvey.label: PRODML DTS Survey
sdg:ProdmlDtsSurvey.definition: A distributed temperature sensing survey process along an installed system, yielding measurement traces.

sdg:ProdmlFiberOpticalPath.label: PRODML Fiber Optical Path
sdg:ProdmlFiberOpticalPath.definition: The installed optical fiber material entity along a wellbore that distributed sensing acquisitions interrogate.

sdg:ProdmlFluidAnalysis.label: PRODML Fluid Analysis
sdg:ProdmlFluidAnalysis.definition: A laboratory analysis process over a fluid sample — PVT studies and compositional assays in the PRODML fluid analysis family.

sdg:ProdmlFluidAnalysisReport.label: PRODML Fluid Analysis Report
sdg:ProdmlFluidAnalysisReport.definition: The reported results of a fluid analysis — the ICE output of the analysis process.

sdg:ProdmlFluidSample.label: PRODML Fluid Sample
sdg:ProdmlFluidSample.definition: A reservoir fluid sample material entity with chain-of-custody, the input to fluid analyses.

sdg:ProdmlProductVolumeReport.label: PRODML Product Volume Report
sdg:ProdmlProductVolumeReport.definition: Reported production volumes and dispositions per well, facility, and period — PRODML's product volume object.

sdg:ProdmlProductionOperationReport.label: PRODML Production Operation Report
sdg:ProdmlProductionOperationReport.definition: Daily production operations reporting: activities, shutdowns, safety events, operational parameters across producing assets.

sdg:ProdmlReport.label: PRODML Report
sdg:ProdmlReport.definition: An information content entity of the PRODML reporting families — the parent of product volume, fluid analysis, production operation reports and sensing datasets.

sdg:ProdmlWell.label: PRODML Well
sdg:ProdmlWell.definition: A well as identified in Energistics energyml common: the engineered material entity whose production PRODML objects report on.

sdg:ProdmlWellbore.label: PRODML Wellbore
sdg:ProdmlWellbore.definition: A wellbore of a well per energyml common — the drilled independent continuant along which sensing installations and tests are located.

sdg:ProductDisclosureStatement.label: product disclosure statement
sdg:ProductDisclosureStatement.definition: A ProductDisclosureStatement is an information content entity that describes some FinancialFund.

sdg:ProfessionalExperience.label: professional experience
sdg:ProfessionalExperience.definition: A process that involves professional practice.

sdg:ProgramOfStudy.label: program of study
sdg:ProgramOfStudy.definition: A structured course of educational instruction designed to lead to the attainment of an academic degree.

sdg:PromotionalCalendarOrder.label: promotional calendar order
sdg:PromotionalCalendarOrder.definition: A PromotionalCalendarOrder is a process that involves an OrderConstraint and specifies a CalendarProductSpecification.

sdg:PropertyAssessmentNotice.label: property assessment notice
sdg:PropertyAssessmentNotice.definition: A property assessment notice is an information content entity that is submitted for approval of a recommendation.

sdg:PropertyOwner.label: property owner
sdg:PropertyOwner.definition: An occupation role held by an individual or entity that legally possesses rights to a specific property or asset.

sdg:ProtectedDisclosureProcess.label: protected disclosure process
sdg:ProtectedDisclosureProcess.definition: A ProtectedDisclosureProcess is a Process that directedTo some ReportingChannel and reportedBy some CollegeOfficial.

sdg:ProviderChangeRequestProcess.label: provider change request process
sdg:ProviderChangeRequestProcess.definition: A ProviderChangeRequestProcess is a Process that has a RequestingClient and targets a RequestedProviderType.

sdg:PublicInformationOfficer.label: public information officer
sdg:PublicInformationOfficer.definition: A government organization role responsible for managing and disseminating public information and media relations.

sdg:QoSConstraint.label: qo s constraint
sdg:QoSConstraint.definition: A quality specification that defines acceptable performance limits or requirements for a service within an agreement.

sdg:QualificationLevel.label: qualification level
sdg:QualificationLevel.definition: An academic degree that indicates statistical significance.

sdg:QualifiedSourceTestingIndividual.label: qualified source testing individual
sdg:QualifiedSourceTestingIndividual.definition: {QualifiedSourceTestingIndividual} is a role that is borne by exactly one {Person}, and that is realized in some {QualifiedSourceTestingProcess}

sdg:QualifiedSourceTestingProcess.label: qualified source testing process
sdg:QualifiedSourceTestingProcess.definition: {QualifiedSourceTestingProcess} is a process that has participant some {SourceTestingCertification}

sdg:QualityImprovementFramework.label: quality improvement framework
sdg:QualityImprovementFramework.definition: A structured quality specification that provides a systematic approach for planning and executing quality improvement initiatives.

sdg:QualityImprovementPresentation.label: quality improvement presentation
sdg:QualityImprovementPresentation.definition: A QualityImprovementPresentation is an InformationContentEntity that addresses some EvidenceBasedMedicine and formulates some QualityImprovementFramework.

sdg:QualityPractice.label: quality practice
sdg:QualityPractice.definition: A QualityPractice is a PracticeSession that is not a QuantityPractice.

sdg:QuantitativeAnalyticTool.label: quantitative analytic tool
sdg:QuantitativeAnalyticTool.definition: A tool specifically designed or utilized to perform numerical analysis and data interpretation within a clinical or research context.

sdg:Raffle.label: raffle
sdg:Raffle.definition: A process that distributes prizes via lot numbers.

sdg:RaffleConductingActivity.label: raffle conducting activity
sdg:RaffleConductingActivity.definition: An organizational activity centered on organizing and executing a raffle draw for fundraising or promotional purposes.

sdg:ReceivingFacilityStaff.label: receiving facility staff
sdg:ReceivingFacilityStaff.definition: Personnel associated with a healthcare facility responsible for receiving and processing communicable disease notifications.

sdg:RecoveredState.label: recovered state
sdg:RecoveredState.definition: A constituent state representing the successful restoration of health or nutritional status following a period of deficiency or illness.

sdg:RegisteredIdentifierBearer.label: registered identifier bearer
sdg:RegisteredIdentifierBearer.definition: Every {RegisteredIdentifierBearer} is a {NaturalPersonRegistrant} or a {RegisteredOrganization} — the union is the superclass, disjunction asserted, not enumerated.

sdg:RegisteredManagerRole.label: registered manager role
sdg:RegisteredManagerRole.definition: {RegisteredManagerRole} is a role that inheres in exactly one {Person}, and that is realized in some {ServiceManagementProcess}

sdg:RegulatoryAuthority.label: regulatory authority
sdg:RegulatoryAuthority.definition: An authority role that exercises regulation over a process.

sdg:RegulatoryBody.label: regulatory body
sdg:RegulatoryBody.definition: A material entity that enforces a process regulation.

sdg:RelationalColumn.label: Relational Column
sdg:RelationalColumn.definition: An information content entity that is a column of a relational schema element.

sdg:RelationalSchemaEntity.label: Relational Schema Entity
sdg:RelationalSchemaEntity.definition: An information content entity that is an element of a relational schema realized from the ontology — the closure class: every generated relational entity is an instance of exactly one of its subclasses.

sdg:RelationalView.label: Relational View
sdg:RelationalView.definition: A derived relational entity composed over tables, intended for embedding generated prose: each view column is an entity knowable completely because it remains grounded in the ontology.

sdg:RenderingEngine.label: rendering engine
sdg:RenderingEngine.definition: An engine that renders an animation sequence creation process.

sdg:ReportingChannel.label: reporting channel
sdg:ReportingChannel.definition: A communication channel that transmits a protected disclosure process.

sdg:RequestedProviderType.label: requested provider type
sdg:RequestedProviderType.definition: A service type that is requested by a provider change request process.

sdg:RequestingClient.label: requesting client
sdg:RequestingClient.definition: A material entity that makes a provider change request process.

sdg:RequestingEntity.label: requesting entity
sdg:RequestingEntity.definition: A material entity that submits a duplicating request.

sdg:ResearchActivity.label: research activity
sdg:ResearchActivity.definition: A research process that is conducted by a young researcher role.

sdg:ResearchManagementActivity.label: research management activity
sdg:ResearchManagementActivity.definition: A ResearchManagementActivity is an occurrent that involves a ResearchProject and an AcademicAgent.

sdg:ResidencyRequirement.label: residency requirement
sdg:ResidencyRequirement.definition: Every instance of ResidencyRequirement qualifies as a DirectiveICE, and each such instance is linked to at least one StudentAgent through the mandatesCompletion relation and to at least one AdministrativeOffice through the enforcedByOffice relation.

sdg:ResponsibleInvestmentFundCollection.label: responsible investment fund collection
sdg:ResponsibleInvestmentFundCollection.definition: A ResponsibleInvestmentFundCollection is an InformationContentEntity that comprises some EthicalInvestmentAsset.

sdg:ResponsiveWebsiteDevelopment.label: responsive website development
sdg:ResponsiveWebsiteDevelopment.definition: A ResponsiveWebsiteDevelopment is a process that targetsPlatform some WebPlatform and employsTechnique some ResponsiveDesignTechnique.

sdg:RetainingEmployeeRole.label: retaining employee role
sdg:RetainingEmployeeRole.definition: {RetainingEmployeeRole} is a role that inheres in exactly one {DepartingEmployee}, and that grants transfer permission some {TransferAuthorization}

sdg:RetirementBenefitOption.label: retirement benefit option
sdg:RetirementBenefitOption.definition: A RetirementBenefitOption is a descriptive information entity that specifies a survivor percentage and specifies guarantee months.

sdg:ReviewPanelSession.label: review panel session
sdg:ReviewPanelSession.definition: A {ReviewPanelSession} is a process that has at least three {PanelReviewer} participants — quorum is structural, not procedural.

sdg:RightsExerciseProcess.label: rights exercise process
sdg:RightsExerciseProcess.definition: {RightsExerciseProcess} is a process that has participant some {IndigenousChild}

sdg:RitualActToRestoreOrder.label: ritual act to restore order
sdg:RitualActToRestoreOrder.definition: A RitualActToRestoreOrder is a BFO process that involves at least one SacredArtifact and aims for a SocialHarmonyRestoration state.

sdg:RolePerception.label: role perception
sdg:RolePerception.definition: RolePerception is an information content entity that cognitivelyRepresents a RoleConcept.

sdg:SafeguardMeasure.label: safeguard measure
sdg:SafeguardMeasure.definition: A SafeguardMeasure is a DirectiveICE that mitigates an AbuseEvent and applies to a gTLDProgram.

sdg:SafeguardingReportProcess.label: safeguarding report process
sdg:SafeguardingReportProcess.definition: SafeguardingReportProcess is an Occurrent that is executedBy a ChildProtectionTeam and directedTo an ExternalAgency.

sdg:SchoolSecurityPolicy.label: school security policy
sdg:SchoolSecurityPolicy.definition: A specifically dependent continuant that specifies rules and procedures for security within a school environment.

sdg:ScientificOrganization.label: scientific organization
sdg:ScientificOrganization.definition: A scientific organization is an artifact that publishes_journal some academic journal and organizes_meetings some scientific meeting.

sdg:ScoredAssessmentRecord.label: scored assessment record
sdg:ScoredAssessmentRecord.definition: A {ScoredAssessmentRecord} carries exactly one decimal confidence score — single-valued by definition.

sdg:SecurityInfrastructure.label: security infrastructure
sdg:SecurityInfrastructure.definition: Security infrastructure is a specific continuant that has some access control mechanism as a direct part.

sdg:SequencingCoverageParameter.label: sequencing coverage parameter
sdg:SequencingCoverageParameter.definition: A sequencing coverage parameter is a descriptive information entity that has exactly one coverage depth decimal value.

sdg:ServiceChargeRate.label: service charge rate
sdg:ServiceChargeRate.definition: A service charge rate is a descriptive metric defined by exactly one PercentageValue.

sdg:ServiceLevelAgreement.label: service level agreement
sdg:ServiceLevelAgreement.definition: A ServiceLevelAgreement is an information content entity that binds a NetworkProvider and specifies a QoSConstraint.

sdg:ServiceManagementProcess.label: service management process
sdg:ServiceManagementProcess.definition: A telemetry process that coordinates the provision of a service type.

sdg:ServicePerformanceMetric.label: service performance metric
sdg:ServicePerformanceMetric.definition: A performance specification that measures the performance of a service type.

sdg:ServiceProvider.label: service provider
sdg:ServiceProvider.definition: A material entity that provides a service function.

sdg:ServiceProvisionActivity.label: service provision activity
sdg:ServiceProvisionActivity.definition: A process that delivers a service type.

sdg:ServiceRequest.label: service request
sdg:ServiceRequest.definition: An act of requesting that requests a service function.

sdg:ServiceStaffRole.label: service staff role
sdg:ServiceStaffRole.definition: {ServiceStaffRole} is a role that has bearer exactly one {RestaurantStaff}, and that is realized in some {ServiceProvisionActivity}

sdg:SignificanceLevel.label: significance level
sdg:SignificanceLevel.definition: A ratio measurement information content entity that indicates the statistical significance of a qualification level.

sdg:SimulationSoftware.label: simulation software
sdg:SimulationSoftware.definition: A computing artifact function that executes an artifact model for simulation purposes.

sdg:SkillImprovement.label: skill improvement
sdg:SkillImprovement.definition: SkillImprovement is grounded as a specific type of increase in a quality, representing the enhancement of an individual's capabilities.

sdg:SlavicLinguisticRoot.label: slavic linguistic root
sdg:SlavicLinguisticRoot.definition: A language that constitutes a historical root for Slavic linguistic development.

sdg:SmallGroupSurchargeRule.label: small group surcharge rule
sdg:SmallGroupSurchargeRule.definition: A small group surcharge rule is a pricing constraint defined by a GroupSizeThreshold and a SurchargeAmount.

sdg:SocialHarmonyRestoration.label: social harmony restoration
sdg:SocialHarmonyRestoration.definition: A social act that restores harmony within a social network.

sdg:SocialMediaAccountAdministrator.label: social media account administrator
sdg:SocialMediaAccountAdministrator.definition: {SocialMediaAccountAdministrator} is a role that is borne by exactly one {DistrictEmployee}, and that is realized in some {SocialMediaAccountManagementProcess}

sdg:SocialMediaAccountManagementProcess.label: social media account management process
sdg:SocialMediaAccountManagementProcess.definition: A process that manages account authorization records for social networking services.

sdg:SocialMediaAccountRegistration.label: social media account registration
sdg:SocialMediaAccountRegistration.definition: A SocialMediaAccountRegistration is an occurrent that requires submission of some LoginCredentials and targets some PublicInformationOfficer.

sdg:SocialNetworkingServicePlatform.label: social networking service platform
sdg:SocialNetworkingServicePlatform.definition: A Social Networking Service Platform is a descriptive information content entity that designates some Social Networking Service Type.

sdg:SocialNetworkingServiceType.label: social networking service type
sdg:SocialNetworkingServiceType.definition: A service type that covers social networking service usage.

sdg:SocialNetworkingServiceUsage.label: social networking service usage
sdg:SocialNetworkingServiceUsage.definition: SocialNetworkingServiceUsage is grounded as a specific instance of a service usage category, representing the activity of utilizing a social networking platform.

sdg:SocialServicesDepartment.label: social services department
sdg:SocialServicesDepartment.definition: A government organization that administers social services.

sdg:SocialTag.label: social tag
sdg:SocialTag.definition: An information content entity that labels social networking service usage.

sdg:SocialTaggingProcess.label: social tagging process
sdg:SocialTaggingProcess.definition: A SocialTaggingProcess is a BFO process that appliesTo some InformationItem and generates some SocialTag.

sdg:SoftwareInterface.label: software interface
sdg:SoftwareInterface.definition: A generically dependent continuant that enables data export to a database.

sdg:SpecificationTestingEvent.label: specification testing event
sdg:SpecificationTestingEvent.definition: A SpecificationTestingEvent is an Occurrent that executes a TestingProtocol and targets a Material.

sdg:StaffSocialMediaAccountAdministrator.label: staff social media account administrator role
sdg:StaffSocialMediaAccountAdministrator.definition: {StaffSocialMediaAccountAdministratorRole} is a role that inheres in exactly one {StaffMember}, and that is realized in some {SocialMediaAccountManagementProcess}

sdg:Stage5Checklist.label: stage5 checklist
sdg:Stage5Checklist.definition: A Stage5Checklist is an information content entity that contains some InspectionChecklistItem.

sdg:StakeholderNeed.label: stakeholder need
sdg:StakeholderNeed.definition: A StakeholderNeed is an InformationContentEntity expressed by some StakeholderRole.

sdg:StandingCommitteeAssembly.label: standing committee assembly
sdg:StandingCommitteeAssembly.definition: A {StandingCommitteeAssembly} is a process with between five and fifteen {CommitteeMember} participants — both bounds carried by the class itself.

sdg:StateAction.label: state action
sdg:StateAction.definition: StateAction is grounded as an Act of Government.

sdg:StorageAllocation.label: storage allocation
sdg:StorageAllocation.definition: A StorageAllocation is a descriptive information content entity that allocates to exactly one Student and provides exactly one CloudStorageVolume.

sdg:StrapFixingProcess.label: strap fixing process
sdg:StrapFixingProcess.definition: A StrapFixingProcess is a BFO process that involves attaching a LateralRestraintStrap and securing it to a BuildingFloorStructure.

sdg:StudentEntrepreneurRole.label: student entrepreneur role
sdg:StudentEntrepreneurRole.definition: A student entrepreneur role is a role that inheres-in exactly one student and realizes in some business initiative.

sdg:SubjectConcept.label: subject concept
sdg:SubjectConcept.definition: A designative information content entity that denotes a specific object or entity.

sdg:SupervisedTestUnitCatalog.label: supervised test unit catalog
sdg:SupervisedTestUnitCatalog.definition: SupervisedTestUnitCatalog is an information content entity that contains some IndustrialEmissionSource.

sdg:SupplierLandscapeSurvey.label: supplier landscape survey
sdg:SupplierLandscapeSurvey.definition: A SupplierLandscapeSurvey is an information content entity that assesses some Supplier and documents some MarketTrend, and has some market growth index.

sdg:SurrogateIdentifierColumn.label: Surrogate Identifier Column
sdg:SurrogateIdentifierColumn.definition: A column bearing a generated identifier designating the row's instance; carries no domain semantics beyond designation.

sdg:SurveyFinding.label: survey finding
sdg:SurveyFinding.definition: SurveyFinding is an information entity that involves some SubstanceType, some PrevalenceRate, and has a percentage value.

sdg:SysmlActionDefinition.label: SysML Action Definition
sdg:SysmlActionDefinition.definition: A behavioral definition of actions a system performs, composable into sequences and control structures.

sdg:SysmlAttributeUsage.label: SysML Attribute Usage
sdg:SysmlAttributeUsage.definition: An attribute usage carrying a typed value slot on a definition or usage.

sdg:SysmlConnectionUsage.label: SysML Connection Usage
sdg:SysmlConnectionUsage.definition: A connection between usages — the modeled link binding ports/parts in a structural decomposition.

sdg:SysmlConstraintDefinition.label: SysML Constraint Definition
sdg:SysmlConstraintDefinition.definition: A parametric constraint definition — an analyzable relation over attribute usages.

sdg:SysmlModelElement.label: SysML Model Element
sdg:SysmlModelElement.definition: An information content entity of a SysMLv2/KerML model — model elements describe systems and are never the described systems themselves.

sdg:SysmlPackage.label: SysML Package
sdg:SysmlPackage.definition: A namespace-owning container model element grouping definitions and usages.

sdg:SysmlPartDefinition.label: SysML Part Definition
sdg:SysmlPartDefinition.definition: A definition of a class of systems or parts — the structural type SysMLv2 part usages instantiate.

sdg:SysmlPartUsage.label: SysML Part Usage
sdg:SysmlPartUsage.definition: A usage of a part within a structural decomposition — the compositional occurrence of a part definition.

sdg:SysmlPortDefinition.label: SysML Port Definition
sdg:SysmlPortDefinition.definition: A definition of an interaction point through which parts connect and exchange.

sdg:SysmlRequirement.label: SysML Requirement
sdg:SysmlRequirement.definition: A requirement definition or usage: a constraint-bearing model element stating what a system shall satisfy, with traceability structure.

sdg:SysmlStateDefinition.label: SysML State Definition
sdg:SysmlStateDefinition.definition: A behavioral definition of system states and transitions — SysMLv2 state-based occurrence modeling.

sdg:SysmlVerificationCase.label: SysML Verification Case
sdg:SysmlVerificationCase.definition: A verification case binding requirements to analysis, inspection, and test evidence — SysMLv2 verification practice.

sdg:TargetMaterial.label: target material
sdg:TargetMaterial.definition: A portion of material that serves as the target of a targeting act.

sdg:TariffStructure.label: tariff structure
sdg:TariffStructure.definition: TariffStructure is grounded as a CatalogStructure.

sdg:TaxiRideProcess.label: taxi ride process
sdg:TaxiRideProcess.definition: An act of travel that involves the use of a vehicle for passenger transport.

sdg:TeamAssessmentEvent.label: team assessment event
sdg:TeamAssessmentEvent.definition: A TeamAssessmentEvent is a process that has some AssessmentParticipant and produces some EvaluationOutcome.

sdg:TeamFunction.label: team function
sdg:TeamFunction.definition: A function that is realized in a crew or team organization.

sdg:TeleSalesActivity.label: tele sales activity
sdg:TeleSalesActivity.definition: A process that conducts sales activities via telephone communication.

sdg:TelemarketerSalesAdministratorRole.label: telemarketer sales administrator role
sdg:TelemarketerSalesAdministratorRole.definition: {TelemarketerSalesAdministratorRole} is a role that inheres in exactly one {Person}, and that is realized in some {SalesAdministrationActivity}

sdg:TelemarketingKPIConstraint.label: telemarketing k p i constraint
sdg:TelemarketingKPIConstraint.definition: A TelemarketingKPIConstraint is an InformationContentEntity that applies to some TelemarketerSalesAdministratorRole, measures some CallVolumeMetric, and specifies a minimumCallsPerHour of type xsd:decimal.

sdg:TelescopeInstrumentArtifact.label: telescope instrument artifact
sdg:TelescopeInstrumentArtifact.definition: A telescope artifact that is functionally configured for astronomical observation.

sdg:TestStatistic.label: test statistic
sdg:TestStatistic.definition: A probability measurement information content entity that results from a hypothesis test.

sdg:ThermalOperatingRangeConstraint.label: thermal operating range constraint
sdg:ThermalOperatingRangeConstraint.definition: A ThermalOperatingRangeConstraint is a descriptive information entity specifying a lower and upper temperature limit for safe operation.

sdg:ThreatInformation.label: threat information
sdg:ThreatInformation.definition: An information bearing entity that describes a vulnerability or risk state.

sdg:TopWorkplaceAward.label: top workplace award
sdg:TopWorkplaceAward.definition: A TopWorkplaceAward is a directive information entity granted by a RecognizingOrganization and verifies HealthStandardCompliance.

sdg:TraditionalReligiousHealerRole.label: traditional religious healer role
sdg:TraditionalReligiousHealerRole.definition: {TraditionalReligiousHealerRole} is a role that is borne by exactly one {HumanAgent}, and that is realized in some {TraditionalReligiousHealingProcess}

sdg:TraditionalReligiousHealingProcess.label: traditional religious healing process
sdg:TraditionalReligiousHealingProcess.definition: {TraditionalReligiousHealingProcess} is a process that has participant some {HumanAgent}

sdg:UnaccompaniedMinorRole.label: unaccompanied minor role
sdg:UnaccompaniedMinorRole.definition: {UnaccompaniedMinorRole} is a role that inheres in exactly one {MinorPerson}, and that is realized in some {TaxiRideProcess}

sdg:UrineDrugScreeningProcedure.label: urine drug screening procedure
sdg:UrineDrugScreeningProcedure.definition: A UrineDrugScreeningProcedure is a clinical process that collects a BiologicalSpecimen and targets an AnalyteTarget.

sdg:VariationMarginRuleSet.label: variation margin rule set
sdg:VariationMarginRuleSet.definition: A VariationMarginRuleSet is a directive ICE that mandates a CollateralExchangeProcess and is verifiedBy a ComplianceAudit.

sdg:VectorControlActivity.label: vector control activity
sdg:VectorControlActivity.definition: A VectorControlActivity is an Occurrent that implements some VectorControlProgram and targets some ResidentialStreet.

sdg:VehiclePowerType.label: vehicle power type
sdg:VehiclePowerType.definition: A vehicle power type is equivalent to either a diesel powered vehicle or a non diesel powered vehicle.

sdg:VenueOperationsOversight.label: venue operations oversight
sdg:VenueOperationsOversight.definition: VenueOperationsOversight is a bfo:0000015 that overseesInfrastructure some FacilityInfrastructure and enforcesProtocol some OperationalProtocol.

sdg:VersionedIntakeForm.label: versioned intake form
sdg:VersionedIntakeForm.definition: A {VersionedIntakeForm} bears at least one version designation string.

sdg:VulnerabilityState.label: vulnerability state
sdg:VulnerabilityState.definition: VulnerabilityState is grounded as a Vulnerability.

sdg:WaterQualityMonitoringActivity.label: water quality monitoring activity
sdg:WaterQualityMonitoringActivity.definition: A WaterQualityMonitoringActivity is a process that uses_standard some DepartmentOfHealthStandard and measures some PoolWaterQualityParameter.

sdg:WavelengthVariant.label: wavelength variant
sdg:WavelengthVariant.definition: A WavelengthVariant is a material continuant that is either a 930nmVariant or a 940nmVariant.

sdg:WeeklySalesReport.label: weekly sales report
sdg:WeeklySalesReport.definition: A WeeklySalesReport is an InformationContentEntity that describes some TeleSalesActivity and is situated_in some ReportingPeriod.

sdg:WeightReductionServiceExecution.label: weight reduction service execution
sdg:WeightReductionServiceExecution.definition: A weight reduction service execution is a process that involves a patient and delivers dietary advice.

sdg:YoungPhysicianEligibilityConstraint.label: young physician eligibility constraint
sdg:YoungPhysicianEligibilityConstraint.definition: A YoungPhysicianEligibilityConstraint is a DescriptiveICE that has_max_age_years some decimal and has_max_practice_years some decimal.

sdg:YoungResearcherResearchProcess.label: young researcher research process
sdg:YoungResearcherResearchProcess.definition: {YoungResearcherResearchProcess} is a process that has participant some {ResearchActivity}

sdg:YoungResearcherRole.label: young researcher role
sdg:YoungResearcherRole.definition: {YoungResearcherRole} is a role that is borne by exactly one {IndependentContinuant}, and that is realized in some {YoungResearcherResearchProcess}

sdg:YouthHealthCareSummary.label: youth health care summary
sdg:YouthHealthCareSummary.definition: A youth health care summary is an information content entity that describes a youth health status and is formatted as an established data format.

sdg:gTLDProgram.label: g t l d program
sdg:gTLDProgram.definition: A g t l d program.
